change.title: Own durable history recovery and optional resume in one backend operation
change.summary: Adds a typed history-recovery transaction around exact Science stop, protected authority snapshot, credential publication, cleanup finalize, and an explicit resume handoff so restore-only remains safely stopped while restore-and-resume uses one backend IPC.

basis: history recovery writes a typed V2 operation and advances stop, snapshot, credential-write intent, credential publication plus finalize, and resume terminal states only by complete-record CAS
runtime_fingerprint freezes Config without its journal; central writers and downgrade preview/commit reject changes while HistoryRecovery is open, and checkpoints, replay, and handoff reject drift
an identity-bound before-image manifest is fsynced before HistoryCredentialWritePending; every credential or marker publication completes file and parent-directory durability barriers before success
restart replay validates Config before effects, re-proves Science quiescence at the frozen port, and exact-CAS clears; pending work converges before provider auth failure or business entry
same-process full snapshot compensation requires equality of the entire expected Config, so a concurrent config writer is preserved with exact recovery evidence instead of being overwritten
restore-only rotates references after credential publication and leaves Science stopped; post-commit failures return degraded with nested rotated references and exact recovery evidence
history cleanup projections omit private snapshot paths from every command DTO
explicit restore-and-resume submits one restore_history_choice IPC, authenticates before the destructive lease, consumes the exact terminal history handoff, and re-enters the existing one-click owner
frontend finalize readback remains authoritative for restore-only and resume; restore-only reports success only for an ok outcome with attention disposition
focused Rust, isolated fake-Science, frontend, quality metadata, documentation governance, exact-SHA source gate, and clean-context review are required for source closure
giant coordinator decomposition, F1-R read model, artifact, installed, live provider or Science, signing, and release behavior remain excluded
